summary: crates/font-engine: added collection_layout() (CollectionLayout/FaceLayout/TableRange) exposing bounded, validated ttcf/sfnt face and table-directory byte ranges. Rejects duplicate table tags and any within-face table overlap; accepts cross-face tables at an exact (offset,length) match as legitimate ttcf sharing and rejects any other cross-face intersection as corruption. numFonts/numTables are bounds-checked against the buffer with checked arithmetic before any Vec sized by the claim is allocated. Reuses the existing bounded readers (reader.rs), no second parser. 8 new synthetic-fixture tests in tests/ttc_layout.rs; existing 65 tests untouched and passing (73 total).
next_action: Await Commander integration. Follow-up option (not done, flagged as scope decision): route parse_with_source's own directory build through collection_layout's duplicate/overlap validation for stricter-by-default parsing.

FT-031.adaptation: Implemented as an additive inspection API (collection_layout + CollectionLayout/FaceLayout/TableRange) layered on the existing table-directory reading in truetype.rs rather than rewiring TrueTypeFace::parse_with_source itself, to keep the existing 65 tests' behavior unchanged under the timebox. Built synthetic ttcf/sfnt fixtures by hand for the duplicate-tag, overlap, and hostile-header cases since no real corrupted TTC fixture was available on this machine; the identical-shared-table acceptance test is built the same way against the documented ttcf structure, not diffed against a specific vendor font.
